column1: # Replay 1.20 stock model physics, from ACTS xmodel / physicsasset exports of 34 zones (tools/build_model_physics_catalog.py; rule: src/core/model_physics.h).
# M <model> <physics asset or -> <detail collision or ->: the XModel's collision (no physics asset: the game gives the model no collision).

# P <physics asset> <body contents, hex> <shape> <why not decoded or ->: shape = convex pieces in model space (inches, Z-up; pieces split by ";", vertices by " ", x,y,z), or "mesh" (not read: use the render mesh).
